declaration.objective: Test hourly breakout invalidation and risk-normalized profit giveback exits without changing original account entry, stop, leverage or risk rules.
declaration.breakout_failure: Two consecutive complete post-entry 1h closes back on or inside the original frozen Donchian breakout boundary. A long close <= boundary or a short close >= boundary is invalidation. Missing hours never count as consecutive.
declaration.giveback: R is abs(actual entry minus immutable initial stop). Use only post-entry completed hourly closes. After a favorable closing-price peak >= 1R, a decline of >= 0.5R from that peak latches a full exit.
declaration.combined: Either fixed exit condition. Preserve both reasons when they trigger on the same close.
declaration.execution: Detect from causal completed bars; execute against the currently observed book with depth limits and adverse slippage. Never fill at a historical trigger close. Original stops and pending exits retain priority; residual quantities retry normally.
declaration.entries: Independent flat 1000-USDT ledgers at one verified exchange inception; only new post-inception signals. Original 1h entry, completed 4h confirmation, 0.25% risk and 3-hour post-exit cooldown are preserved. No automatic reversal.
declaration.costs: Double both taker-fee and adverse-slippage assumptions; use the same public funding rates and settlement observations. Each cost arm sizes and trades independently, so paths may differ.
declaration.pairing: Match symbol, cost, original signal boundary and direction, not trade sequence. Follow early-exit opportunities until the matching baseline closes. Unfinished and unmatched paths remain explicit. Include subsequent candidate trades, fees and funding.
declaration.threshold_selection: Fixed generic risk-unit hypotheses, no parameter sweep or fitting to the recent losses. The two reviewed positions did not reach 1R in sampled quotes, so this giveback rule must not be claimed to rescue them.
declaration.first_review: At least 14 days and 10 complete positions per symbol/arm. Require sufficient completed matched early-exit followups before claiming an exit improvement. Review readiness is not a pass or promotion.
declaration.promotion_evidence: Per-symbol positive net returns after estimated open-position close costs at normal and double costs; positive return difference to its cost-matched baseline without worse sampled drawdown; inspect best-winner dependence, lost continuation and added churn. No automatic pass.
declaration.known_history: Any replay of already inspected observations is a diagnostic, not independent unseen validation or forward performance. Never backfill the new live epoch.
